## Summary

<!-- What does this change do, and why? -->

## Related issue

<!-- For example: Closes #123. Write "None" if there is no related issue. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] feat: new feature
- [ ] fix: bug fix
- [ ] docs: documentation only
- [ ] chore: maintenance
- [ ] refactor: no behavior change
- [ ] test: tests only

## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request title follows Conventional Commits (`<type>: <summary>`).
- [ ] The change is small and focused on one thing.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where the change affects it.
- [ ] Tests and checks that exist in the project pass (or none exist yet).
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
